description: Flavour graph for Sump. Called by script_venue_regular via the trigger's voice param.

f0.text: The room adjusts around you the way a room adjusts around furniture it has stopped noticing.

f1.text: An argument pauses so both parties can ask you to settle it. Neither will accept your answer.

f2.text: The bartender puts a glass down and taps the bar twice. You have no idea what it means. You know exactly what it means.

r0.text: The bartender pours without asking and doesn't watch the glass, which is the closest thing to trust available here.

r1.text: Two people move apart at the bar. The gap they leave is exactly one person wide.

r2.text: Somebody says your name without turning around, purely to confirm they still can.

s0.text: Conversation doesn't stop when you walk in. It just gets quieter and more specific.

s1.text: A man at the end of the bar looks at your shoes for a long time and comes to a conclusion about you.

s2.text: Nobody offers you a seat. There are eleven free seats.

name: Venue voice — Sump
